_comment: SHA-256 digests for the upstream native binaries embedded into release builds via the stado_embed_binaries build tag. Pinned per version per asset filename — independent of any digest the upstream release page advertises at fetch time. Reviewable in source control (this file is the audit anchor); changing a digest requires a reviewable commit that names the new upstream version. Reasoning: pre-Cluster-T fetch-binaries.go fetched .sha256 sidecars (ripgrep) and expanded_assets HTML (ast-grep) from the SAME GitHub upstream release source as the binaries themselves — an upstream account compromise could replace BOTH the asset AND its advertised digest, and stado release builds would embed the swapped bytes with a self-consistent SHA. Codex validated finding (HIGH attack-path) closed by switching to these committed pins.
